t:
Section 5(b) of the Act entitled “An Act creating a commission to be known as the Commission on Obscenity and Pornography”, approved October 3, 1967 (Public Law 90–100), is amended by striking out “January 31, 1970” and inserting in lieu thereof “July 31, 1970”.
This Act may be cited as the “Treasury, Post Office, and Executive Office Appropriation Act, 1969”.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that mentioning the Commission on Obscenity and Pornography signals an advisory body with outside members. But this section only changes a date in the earlier Act and supplies a short title for the appropriation Act. It does not itself create the commission, appoint outside members, or require any consultation, hearing, comment period, or right to sue.
fable.s: is amended by striking out “January 31, 1970” and inserting in lieu thereof “July 31, 1970”
